<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="321" y1="16" x2="326" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="13" x2="330" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="10" x2="335" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="14" x2="350" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="9" width="19" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="11" width="14" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="381" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header and progress -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="34,61 25,70 34,79" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="26" y1="70" x2="43" y2="70" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">PROFILE SETUP</text>
    <rect x="25" y="96" width="340" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="25" y="96" width="170" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="98.5" r="4.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="25" y="142" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">How do you identify?</text>
    <text x="25" y="169" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the option that best represents you.</text>
    <text x="25" y="188" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You can update this anytime in your profile settings.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ethnicity options -->
  <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="204" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="253" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="302" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="351" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="400" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="449" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="498" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="547" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="596" width="342" height="43" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Option labels -->
  <g>
    <text x="43" y="231" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Hispanic or Latino</text>
    <text x="43" y="280" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">White</text>
    <text x="43" y="329" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Black or African American</text>
    <text x="43" y="378" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Asian</text>
    <text x="43" y="427" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">American Indian or Alaska Native</text>
    <text x="43" y="476" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander</text>
    <text x="43" y="525" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Middle Eastern or North African</text>
    <text x="43" y="574" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Prefer not to say</text>
    <text x="43" y="623" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Multiracial</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Radio controls -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="342" cy="225.5" r="10" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <polyline points="337,225 341,229 348,221" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="274.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="323.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="372.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="421.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="470.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="519.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="568.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="617.5" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="661" width="340" height="46" rx="23" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="25" y="658" width="340" height="46" rx="23" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="687" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="48,779 38,787 38,798 45,798 45,790 51,790 51,798 58,798 58,787" fill="#FE3675"/>
      <text x="48" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">DISCOVER</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="126" cy="786" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="122,786 125,789 131,782" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="126" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="195" y="778" width="19" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="199,793 202,798 206,793" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="201" cy="785" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="207" cy="785" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="204" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">CHAT</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="282" cy="783" r="5" fill="#939393"/>
      <ellipse cx="282" cy="797" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="282" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="348" cy="787" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="348" cy="787" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="348" y1="776" x2="348" y2="773" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="348" y1="801" x2="348" y2="798" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="348" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">SETTINGS</text>
    </g>
    <rect x="157" y="833" width="76" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
